title: Painting a Plane
content: If you thought painting a canvas or a mural was a big job, how about painting a jet? This time-lapse video shows all the prepping, spraying and frisketing involved.It takes more than 50 gallons of paint to cover a commercial jet, and that layer adds about 400 pounds to the weight.Some airlines have chosen a brushed aluminum finish to save on the weight and increase efficiency.------Direct link to the Virgin Atlantic video.A different time lapse video, painting a Delta jet using cherry pickers instead of scaffolding.Via Best of YouTube
